snippet.title: Bad Piggies - King Pig's Hunt (PART 2 Update & Mobile Teaser Trailer)
snippet.description:
After 3 years of developement, Bad Piggies KPH is almost ready for it's newest major update ! With optimised performances, containing fresh episodes with 21 levels in total, new playable characters and bosses !

Ft. Liella, and the Nijigasaki School Idol Club, eat all eggs and beat 'em all ! 
----------------------------------
The update is releasing on July 7 for Windows and this time on Android !
https://kingpiggamestudios-kpgs.itch.io/bad-piggies-kph
